blocking_issues: Several NSI quantitative claims in the staged text are not reconciled with the cited/current official series. The report states Q1 2026 exports of goods and services -7.4% y/y, imports +8.2%, gross fixed capital formation +9.1%, house prices +14.8% and labour costs +13.4%, while the official NSI key-indicator releases available for 2026 show materially different vintages/values. The report must identify the exact NSI release/vintage for each figure or update the figures and dependent interpretation.

The central thesis says euro adoption and MSCI reclassification are reducing financial frictions, but the evidence directly demonstrates institutional integration and improved classification/accessibility, not yet realized reductions in financing costs, persistent portfolio inflows or deeper liquidity. The causal language in title/deck and assessment must be narrowed or supported with observed post-adoption/post-reclassification data.

The transmission-map arrow chains compress causal claims into slogans. Under EDITORIAL-STYLE.md and the Strategic Transitions gate, the prose must explicitly state mechanisms, conditions and countervailing channels rather than relying on arrows such as fiscal expansion + wage growth → imports/inflation → wider deficit/external pressure.

The report needs a clearer, explicit section stating what evidence would weaken or reverse the assessment. The architecture requires Strategic Transitions to identify evidence that would invalidate the thesis, not only catalysts and monitoring variables.
required_fixes: Reconcile every disputed NSI figure against a dated primary release. For each changed series, state the reference period and publication/vintage; update both EN and PT-BR tables/prose identically and revise conclusions if magnitudes change.

Distinguish demonstrated institutional changes (euro membership, TARGET/ECMS integration, MSCI classification) from inferred economic effects. Replace claims that frictions are already being reduced with conditional language unless transaction-cost, spread, flow, custody, settlement or liquidity evidence demonstrates the effect.

Rewrite the transmission section in explanatory prose: identify the acting agent or economic variable, the mechanism, the conditions under which transmission occurs and the consequence. Arrow diagrams may remain only as supplements.

Add an explicit 'What would change our assessment?' section and semantic equivalent in PT-BR, including observable falsifiers such as fiscal consolidation without growth damage, productivity catching wage growth, current-account normalization, durable liquidity/free-float improvement, or evidence that euro integration does not materially change financing/access conditions.
Perform a final bilingual equivalence pass after factual corrections so numbers, confidence, evidence status and conclusions remain identical across EN and PT-BR.

evidence.finding: Bulgaria adopted the euro and became the 21st euro-area member; the Bulgarian National Bank joined the Eurosystem and became a full SSM member. This supports the institutional-change premise.
Bulgaria completed onboarding to T2, T2S, TIPS and ECMS. This demonstrates infrastructure integration, but by itself does not quantify lower financing costs or deeper market liquidity.
MSCI reclassified Bulgaria from Standalone to Frontier Market status. This supports improved classification/accessibility, not an investment endorsement or proof of persistent inflows.
The Commission reports 2026 GDP growth 2.5%, inflation 4.2%, general-government balance -4.1% of GDP, debt 32.3% and current account -5.0%; these central forecast figures are corroborated.

evidence.source: Bulgarian NSI key indicators, 3 April 2026 and later 2026 releases
evidence.finding: Official series show changing vintages for trade, investment, labour costs and house prices. The staged report cites a generic later NSI key-indicators URL while presenting figures that require exact release/vintage reconciliation before approval.

notes: Taxonomy v1.0 classification itself passes: strategic-transitions is valid; economy, politics and society are all declared and materially connected; geography, topics, format and cadence are controlled values. Rejection is factual/methodological/editorial, not taxonomic. No public bundle or global site surface was changed.
